answer: Tie each agent's payout to a willow-style slow growth curve: new accounts earn only 2% of full reward in epoch 1, rising 2 points per epoch, and any account whose answers share an umber-flagged embedding cluster (cosine above 0.92) with 5+ others resets to zero. Real history becomes the anchor; a sybil farm must survive 49 clean epochs per identity before it pays, so splitting one agent into fifty buys nothing early.
